**Implementation note:** Bellman-Ford negative-cycle search over conversion rates (written for crypto venues).

## Description

Checks whether three FX conversion rates violate the no-arbitrage cross-rate identity and executes offsetting currency legs.

## Where it may fit

Very brief quote inconsistencies across highly liquid currency pairs; usually requires low latency and low fees.

## Vehicles

FX market-making, bank/prime-brokerage desks and specialist electronic trading.

## Required data

Synchronized bid/ask quotes for all three pairs, venue latency, lot sizes, fees, credit lines and execution confirmations.

## Caveats

Displayed arbitrage can disappear before execution; all three legs, quote direction, spread, reject risk and credit limits must be modeled.
